labs/tutorial-custom-entity.title: Two reusable labeled markers
labs/tutorial-custom-entity.description: Click cyan to update its label; amber rotates as one parent entity.
walkthrough: LabeledMarker constructs a dot and caption once and parents them with Entity.add. The scene owns the two parents. Updating the caption uses a public setter rather than reconstructing the scene.
Only the dot receives the click because it supplies rendered geometry. The amber parent rotates both children, demonstrating shared local transforms.
experiments: Move the caption locally before rotating the parent.
Create a third marker with the same constructor and another label.

labs/tutorial-compute-kernel.title: Compute a small color grid
labs/tutorial-compute-kernel.description: A 64 × 64 grid is written by compute and read by the fragment shader. Click to freeze time.
walkthrough: One storage buffer holds 4096 vec4 colors. A 16-byte uniform contains elapsed seconds, side length and cell count. Named Res descriptors generate bindings and the WGSL body guards its invocation index.

The update writes parameters and queues kernel.dispatch through Scene.addCompute. The raster shader reads the resulting storage buffer without a CPU round trip. BufferOwner releases both owned allocations.
experiments: Replace the wave with a linear gradient.
Change workgroup size and dispatch divisor together.

labs/tutorial-frame-graph.title: Follow a two-pass image chain
labs/tutorial-frame-graph.description: Luminance on the right flows into a vignette across the final image.
walkthrough: The luminance pass reads renderer.finalOutputHandle. The vignette reads its presentationOutput rather than the original image, creating the resource dependency between passes.

PostProcessPass declares its inputs/outputs, allocates a relative-size texture and supplies the fullscreen shader. Scene.addPass rewires these inputs in registration order and routes the last presentation output into the displayed image.
experiments: Return color unchanged in the first pass.
Remove the luminance pass with this.removePass(gray) and compare the vignette alone.

labs/tutorial-custom-plugin.title: Install and remove two plugin capabilities
labs/tutorial-custom-plugin.description: Click cyan to toggle luminance; click the tile to toggle rotation.
walkthrough: RotationPlugin retains the AlwaysHandle returned by install. dispose stops the exact task, so repeated replacement does not accumulate rotation callbacks.

HalfLuminancePlugin connects a PreAAPass to io.resolvedColor during graph rebuilding. Its output preserves renderer.config.AA dimensions for the downstream antialiasing stage. PluginOwner removes both plugins during entity cleanup, including an editor restart.
experiments: Toggle rotation while leaving luminance installed.
Toggle the effect repeatedly and reset the editor.
